description: CapabilityAnnouncement WITH the optional RTC browser-leaf fields set — the three Stage 4a ones (noise_pubkey, rtc_bootstrap, rtc_addr) plus Stage 6's separately announced STUN endpoint (rtc_stun_addr). Each is optional and omitted when None — the sibling fixture capability_announcement.json is the same announcement WITHOUT them, and its bytes are unchanged by Stage 4a and by Stage 6. Declaration order puts them after owner_cert with rtc_stun_addr immediately after rtc_addr, and SignedPayloadCanonical emits them in that order, so these bytes are also the signed transcript. rtc_stun_addr is a host:port STRING (a DNS name is legal) and is deliberately a DIFFERENT endpoint from rtc_addr: a leaf's iceServers points at it, while rtc_addr stays the ICE endpoint and the diagnostic STUN probe target.
